coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Three of six ground-truth variable items substantially match: differentiation method, forward/backward computation time, and numerical stability assessed through gradient norms and comparisons. Platform coverage is incomplete.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design omits distributed multi-GPU execution and replaces ResNet18/ResNet50 with other architectures. It varies the optimizer between SGD and Adam instead of holding Adam fixed, and does not clearly fix learning rate, batch size, and identical training pipelines. Numerical stability measurements omit loss evolution. Additional experimental factors do not replace these required controls and conditions.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states the expected reduction in computation and improvement in numerical stability, or their verification through time and memory comparisons against traditional back-propagation.
